title: Tank level control
brief: Control the pump using two digital level switches.
requirements: Low Level Wet (I0.0) becomes ON when water reaches the lower level switch. High Level Wet (I0.1) becomes ON when water reaches the upper level switch.
Run Pump Motor (Q0.0) only when Low Level Wet (I0.0) and High Level Wet (I0.1) are both OFF. This means the water is below both switches.
If either switch becomes ON, switch Pump Motor (Q0.0) OFF immediately. The pump must also remain OFF if the upper switch is ON but the lower switch is OFF.
No memory is required. When both switches return to OFF, the pump should run again.
hints: A sensor being OFF can be tested with an NC LAD contact.
Use two negated contacts in series.
